description: Post a reply under one comment on an HTMLAnnotate page, as the page owner. Everyone in that thread gets an email. Confirm the wording with the user first. To change a comment's status instead, use resolve_comment or set_comment_status.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

number.description: The comment number as shown by get_comments, like 3 for #3.

text.description: The reply as plain text. Everyone in the thread can read it.

name: reply_to_comment
title: Reply to a comment
